extracted.intended_audience: fiction line editors, copyeditors and proofreaders (beginners to intermediate), and experienced non-fiction editors switching to fiction
extracted.subtask_description: Creating clear, professional editorial reports for fiction manuscripts that explain what was changed and why, offer honest solutions, validate the editor's work, and help authors improve their craft. Emphasises structure, presentation, pedagogical value and efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: COMPREHENSIVE
rubrics_metrics.description: Rich in detail – additional value that will knock your author's socks off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include thorough, substantive commentary rather than only surface edits; provide extra-value detail that helps the author understand issues and see the worth of the edit. The course supplies sample reports and a booklet to model comprehensive reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: CRITICAL
rubrics_metrics.description: Packed with honest, professional analyses of the problems you've found and clear explanations of the solutions you've offered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be candid and professional about problems in the manuscript and pair each critique with a clear, actionable solution. Use examples and explicit explanation so the author can understand and act on the critique.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSTRUCTIVE
rubrics_metrics.description: Mindful of the author's emotional, financial and physical investment in their writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame feedback to support the author's confidence and development: avoid gratuitous harshness, offer encouragement, and prioritise usefulness given the author's resources and goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show the 'why' of your edits
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction editing isn't just about amending a book file or suggesting changes in comments boxes. It's also about communicating the why of our editing practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the rationale behind edits so authors understand your decisions, which demonstrates skill, increases trust, and deepens the author's craft. Provide concrete reasons and examples rather than unexplained corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear structure and presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Presented clearly and beautifully ... I'll show you what to include in your reports, how to structure the information, and how to frame it so that it validates your work and deepens the author's craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a logical structure (cover page, sections, styles) and attractive formatting to make reports navigable and professional. The course includes templates, tutorials on cover pages and styles, and a clickable checklist to keep navigation of report content simple.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency without compromising quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Teach you how to write amazing reports efficiently – without compromising on quality or detail – using the ready-to-go template that editors and authors adore.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt templates, checklists, and exemplar phrasing to reduce writing time while retaining thoroughness. Use ready-made resources (template, sample text, checklist) to streamline report production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide concrete examples and model text
rubrics_metrics.description: This course gives valuable examples of what to write in each section. Sample reports shared with the kind permission of two indie authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include exemplar sentences/paragraphs and whole sample reports so authors see exactly how to phrase critiques and solutions; use these as models when writing your own report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validate your work and deepen the author's craft
rubrics_metrics.description: A template that validates your work and deepens your author's craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design report content that both documents the editor's professional contribution (so clients see value) and contains pedagogical elements that teach the author—e.g., explanations of principles, examples of improvement, and suggestions for rewriting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptability across report types
rubrics_metrics.description: I found it useful for my manuscript assessments too ... a lot of what's discussed can be applied there.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the report framework can be applied to different project types (line-edit reports, manuscript assessments) by tailoring sections and depth to the commission while keeping the same core structure and approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility of course materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Closed captions: Students who are Deaf or hard of hearing can access the audiovisual material via closed captions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When producing instructional or audiovisual content for editors (or when sharing reports that include AV), provide closed captions and accessible formats so materials are usable by people with hearing impairments.
